create_nixl_connector: create a NixlConnector instance with vLLM config, role, and KV cache config for scheduler or worker
build_nixl_connector_stats: build NixlKVConnectorStats from optional data dictionary for KV transfer statistics
build_nixl_prom_metrics: build NixlPromMetrics from vLLM config, metric types, label names, and per-engine label values
get_required_kvcache_layout: get the required KV cache layout (HND) from vLLM config, skipping MLA models
get_num_new_matched_tokens: get the number of newly matched tokens for a request during scheduling
build_connector_meta: build KVConnectorMetadata from scheduler output for KV transfer between workers
get_finished: get finished receiving and sending request IDs from the Nixl connector worker
register_kv_caches: register KV cache tensors on the Nixl connector worker side
